name: Rivalry
overview: Scripture reveals that rivalry stems from pride and selfish ambition, leading to disputes over greatness and causing confusion and evil works, as seen in Mark 9:34 and James 3:16. Such strife contrasts sharply with the unity and humility God desires, where believers are called to be likeminded and of one accord (Philippians 2:2) and to receive grace by humbling themselves before God (James 4:6). Rivalry, including sibling rivalry, reflects the works of the flesh that disrupt the peace and joy meant to characterize the Christian community (Galatians 5:19).
